messages:
Tara: quick run-through of the new Performance dashboard chart. two things stood out: unit placement is ambiguous and the legend order jumps around when series hide/unhide :thinking_face:
Alex: can you paste the screenshot? if unit is only in the axis label (e.g., "Requests / sec") but ticks are raw (0, 250, 500) that forces scanning back-and-forth.
Maria: +1. suggestion: for rate/counter metrics show compact tick suffixes (250r/s or 250 req/s) so each tick carries its unit. for `time` metrics (ms/s) keep label unit but also show unit on hover tooltip.
Sam: UX trade: putting unit on every tick increases clutter for large charts. maybe only show unit suffix on major ticks (every other) and keep label as fallback. we should test with long series names.
Josh: legend behavior: when you toggle series off the list reorders by visible series which confuses people trying to find patterns. keep the legend order stable (always same series order) and dim hidden items instead of moving them.
Tara: accessibility nits: legend entries need an ARIA role and keyboard navigation (left/right to move, space to toggle). current focus target is the color swatch only and has no accessible name.
Maria: color contrast: internal-grey (#9aa0a6) fails AA on small labels. either move to #757f85 or add a patterned fill in the legend swatch (diagonal stripes) for color-blind detection.
Alex: microcopy tweak for smoothing: label the control `Smoothing (trend view)` with a tooltip: "Applies cubic spline smoothing. Hides short spikes; recommended for long-term trends, not for SLO alerting." default state: off for latency/SLO charts.
Sam: outlier handling: current clip-to-max compresses the 10th-90th range. option A: clip + small inset sparkline/hist showing outlier tail. option B: two-axis histogram overlay. preferring A for clarity.
Josh: small code example for tick formatting we can reuse in implementation: ```js
const fmt = (v, metric) => metric.type === 'rate' ? `${v} req/s` : metric.type === 'time' ? `${v} ms` : `${v}`;
```
Tara: decision summary so far: 1) stable legend order + dimming, 2) add ARIA labels and keyboard nav for legend, 3) unit-on-major-ticks for dense charts / tick-suffix for rates, 4) smoothing default off for SLOs and clarified tooltip, 5) clip outliers but include inset summary.
Maria: action items: @Alex - update mockups for tick suffix + major tick rule; @Sam - add keyboard interaction spec; @Josh - prototype inset histogram; @Tara - write small a11y checklist and add to PR.
Design Bot: Reminder: design-review meeting Fri 9:30am. Agenda preset: Legend nav a11y, unit formatting, outlier inset prototype.
Tara: thanks all. will upload updated frames before Thu EOD and add inline comments on the PR. :rocket:
